name: perf_crash_cub_nosedown
what: THE CUB'S CRASH AS A PLAYER MAKES IT (the user, 22 Nov: "Just take off, and crash it ... Just get it nose down when it's 20 meters up, and it will crash just fine"): the roll-out, the skip to the runway's start, the take-off to 50 m (the user, a minute later: "50m high would be better"), then the hand takes the aeroplane (FLIGHT_PROBE.setManual) and holds the stick fully forward until it is in the ground; the wreck orbited. No teleport: the flight is continuous to the impact (row 14).

steps.name: the nose down, into the ground
steps.js: (() => { const P = window.FLIGHT_PROBE; P.setManual(true, 'rig'); const I = P.input(); if (window.__NOSE) clearInterval(window.__NOSE); let n = 0; window.__NOSE = setInterval(() => { try { I.setAxis('pitch', -1); if (++n > 1500 || P.over()) clearInterval(window.__NOSE); } catch (e) { clearInterval(window.__NOSE); } }, 16); I.setAxis('pitch', -1); return 'manual ' + P.manual() + ', the stick HELD forward (pitch axis ' + I.axis('pitch') + '), agl ' + (+P.agl()).toFixed(1); })()
